function xdot = sea_nonlinear_rhs(x, tau, p, d) %SEA_NONLINEAR_RHS Full eight-state nonlinear dynamics of the 2R SEA robot. % X = [q; qdot; theta; thetadot] is an 8-by-1 state vector and TAU is % the 2-by-1 motor torque in N*m. The output follows the same state order. assert(numel(x) == 8, 'sea_nonlinear_rhs:InvalidState', ... 'The state must contain exactly eight elements.'); assert(numel(tau) == 2, 'sea_nonlinear_rhs:InvalidInput', ... 'The motor torque must contain exactly two elements.'); x = reshape(x, 8, 1); tau = reshape(tau, 2, 1); q = x(1:2); qdot = x(3:4); theta = x(5:6); thetadot = x(7:8); M = sea_link_inertia(q, p); C = sea_coriolis(q, qdot, p); G = sea_gravity(q, p); tauElastic = sea_elastic_torque(q, theta, p); qddot = M \ (tauElastic - C * qdot - G); thetaddot = p.Jm \ (tau - p.Bm * thetadot - tauElastic); xdot = [qdot; qddot; thetadot; thetaddot]; end
